name: Exterior Porch Floor Protection & Setup
intent: Wall base masking (LF), railing base masking (LF), door threshold masking (EA), landscape protection (LF), hardscape protection (LF), furniture clearing (SF heuristic), equipment setup.
doctrine: Porch floor protection. Ground-level — no height modifier. Wall base + railing base + hardscape + landscape are LF-based off PaintScope inputs. Door threshold EA. Furniture clearing SF heuristic at 500 SF/hr off floor area. Mobilization 45 min fixed (floor-specific equipment load).
